item.title: Swinney Says Westminster Chaos Shows Status Quo is Unravelling
item.description: A new poll suggests the SNP is within one seat of a majority at Holyrood, as John Swinney says “constant chaos” at Westminster shows the status quo is unravelling ahead of May’s election.The post Swinney Says Westminster Chaos Shows Status Quo is Unravelling appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal to Trace Missing Hill Walker on Ben Nevis
item.description: Police have renewed their appeal to trace 64 year old hill walker Brian Mcgillicuddy, missing on Ben Nevis since 19th of February 2026, as extensive searches continue in challenging conditions around the CIC Hut and Orion Face Direct.The post Appeal to Trace Missing Hill Walker on Ben Nevis appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Character Filled Coastal Home in The Heart of Fortrose
item.description: Set in the heart of Fortrose on the Black Isle, Bishop’s Cottage is a four bedroom detached home with mature gardens and flexible living space, just a short walk from the Moray Firth coastline and village amenities.The post A Character Filled Coastal Home in The Heart of Fortrose appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Two Die After Early Morning Crash on A830 Near Fort William
item.description: A crash on the A830 near Fort William has left two people dead, with police appealing for witnesses and dash cam footage as investigations continue into the early morning collision.The post Two Die After Early Morning Crash on A830 Near Fort William appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Greens Pledge Free Bus Travel for All
item.description: The Scottish Greens have pledged to introduce free bus travel for everyone in Scotland, building on the under 22 scheme and funding the move through higher taxes on the super rich and corporations.The post Scottish Greens Pledge Free Bus Travel for All appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Swinney Says SNP Working Ever Harder To Win Shetland
item.description: John Swinney says the SNP is “working ever harder” to win Shetland in May, pointing to a narrow 806 vote gap in 2021 and urging island voters to seize what he calls a clear opportunity.The post Swinney Says SNP Working Ever Harder To Win Shetland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: HIE Awards £100,000 To Support 32 New Affordable Homes in West Highlands
item.description: Highlands and Islands Enterprise has awarded £100,000 to support 32 new affordable homes in Applecross and Lochaline, helping community groups tackle rural housing shortages and strengthen long term economic resilience.The post HIE Awards £100,000 To Support 32 New Affordable Homes in West Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New National Islands Plan Sets Out Housing and Connectivity Drive
item.description: A new National Islands Plan has been launched with commitments on housing, healthcare, transport links and economic growth as ministers aim to boost population and opportunity across Scotland’s islands.The post New National Islands Plan Sets Out Housing and Connectivity Drive appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scotland To Send 280 Tonnes of Fishing Nets To Help Ukraine Defend Against Drones
item.description: More than 280 tonnes of used fishing nets from Scotland are being sent to Ukraine to help protect roads and infrastructure from Russian drone attacks as the war approaches its fourth anniversary.The post Scotland To Send 280 Tonnes of Fishing Nets To Help Ukraine Defend Against Drones appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Overnight Resurfacing Works Across A82 at Glencoe and Onich
item.description: Overnight resurfacing works are under way on the A82 at Glencoe and near Onich, with lane closures, convoy systems and temporary road closures in place through to 20th of March.The post Overnight Resurfacing Works Across A82 at Glencoe and Onich appeared first on The Highland Times.
